name: University of Rio Grande
oos_note: Out-of-state tuition & fees $20,000/yr (30 credit hrs, excludes room/board/fees) from official rio.edu/affordability-aid/tuition-fees page, 2026-2027 academic year. Rio Grande is a hybrid private university + public community college that charges residency-based rates (In-District $12,790, Ohio $13,240 matching known in-state, WV $14,950, Out-of-State $20,000).
